technology_name: AN AIR ACTUATED RADIAL ROBOTIC GRIPPER ATTACHABLE TO A ROBOT MANIPULATOR ARM
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard robotic end-effectors are heavy, use power-hungry complex motor systems, and smash fragile or non-uniform handling objects due to a lack of passive structural compliance.
description: A lightweight, high-speed pneumatic robotic end-effector tool comprising an array of two symmetric baseplates with custom-spaced complementary slots, air-actuated radial gripping jaws, and an integrated spring-loaded safety mechanical lock.
applications: Automated pick-and-place assembly cells, fragile food-product packaging networks, logistics parcel sortation arms, and specialized manufacturing material loading grids.
